I'm not Catholic. I'm Protestant. But no matter what you say, there's a lot of baggage with it, so it becomes difficult to convey. But I believe that the heart of people um really falls back on greed and fear and uh then you know hatefulness and that sort of thing i don't believe that people are incapable of good there's a lot of with the freedom of religion freedom of speech um with the correct checks and balances that protect from mob rule and also from an individual having too much power uh it's never going to be perfect there's always going to be back and forth but it's up to every generation to try to make things as right as they can and they're going to course correct from the past and then the next generation is going to course correct from them i don't believe we can arrive at a perfect situation or a perfect society forever but it's the job of every generation to try until the lord comes i i don't believe that america is perfect i think that a lot of its concepts are the closest we'll get to a sustainable society uh now i i'm referring more to its inception and then its moral corrections over time so um that women can vote that men and women are equal that all races are equal that uh there's freedom of religion that sort of thing i think that when you implement all those things i think that's about as close as you can get to a perfect society.
